purpose: one fixed packet-only rule/signature comparison; development evidence, no capture or deployment
bucket_rule: smallest checkpoint >= actual observed length, regardless of requested cap; identical observed inputs always use the same profile
training_examples: same public and local training flows/prefix caps as the paired forest; four capped prefixes per training flow, including identical short prefixes
training_mass: 0.75 public plus 0.25 local, local classes balanced identically to paired forest
fitting: per actual-length bucket: weighted global IQR scales with fixed floors; per class weighted 5/50/95 feature quantiles; no optimization or selection-data tuning
nearest_signature: mean absolute training-IQR-scaled distance to class medians; fixed class-order tie break; raw ranking only, not a correctness probability
rule: all ten observed features inside a class's training 5-95% box with 1e-12 numerical tolerance; answer only when exactly one eligible class box matches and >=5 actual packets; otherwise abstain
local_protocol: same 14 chronological development connections and 54 valid 5/10/20/30 points; targets from independent browser references
public_protocol: same first50/class historical public selection cohort as paired models, using actual available prefix capped at each checkpoint
seed_note: deterministic quantiles, rules and class-order tie break; paired frozen models use deployment seed17
activity_rules_check: feature/window availability only; activity ground truth and structural protocol fields are absent, so no activity accuracy or app labels are fabricated
comparison_metrics: raw nearest-class top1 accuracy, observed-class macro-F1, per-class recall per budget; rule coverage/error separately overall and per class; same cohort and all saved predictions
prohibited_inputs: domains, IPs, process names, payload content and activity filenames as predictive features
stop_rule: one fixed comparison; no threshold/feature sweep or retries to improve the score after selection labels are read
limits: Earlier selection already informed other development; this is a post-failure diagnostic, not independent validation. Different fitted preprocessing is training-only and exported. No DNS/nDPI/name shortcut or direct activity-to-app mapping. No new live claim.
